body.description: Request body (UTF-8 text) for body conditions.

files.description: Metadata only; content is fetched per file.

total_size.description: Body plus files, in characters (binary counted as base64 length).

size.description: Characters for text, base64 length for binary content.

hostname.description: Client host name (sanitized; used to name the minted key).

api_key.description: Workspace API key (`auk_`); returned exactly once.

anchor.description: `creator` | `workspace`; changing it needs `can_own` and is audited (RFE-021).
`creator` | `workspace`; changing it needs `can_own` and is audited (RFE-021).

enabled.description: `true` re-enables (clears the failure count; the caller becomes the authority anchor).

secret.description: Shared secret; required when choosing a kind (or switching to one). Never returned.

VerificationView.description: Verification as exposed: never contains the secret.

oneOf.description: Provenance when `anchor = workspace`; the fire-time authority when `anchor = creator`.

url_prefix.description: Display prefix of the capability token (the full URL is shown once).

id.description: Also the `delivery_id` returned to the sender.

status.description:
`accepted` | `rejected_signature` | `rejected_size` | `disabled` | `unauthorized`
(`duplicate` deliveries are answered with the original id and not logged).

WebhookWithUrl.description: Returned by create and rotate: the URL embeds the token and is shown once.
